descriptionChirho: The proper name Talmai, referring to either the Anakite king of Hebron or the father of Maacah (Absalom's wife). All 6 occurrences denote the same personal name. S145213 covers standalone and case-inflected forms (eng 'Talmai', spa 'Talmai', arb 'تَلْمايَ/تَلْمَايَ', kor '달매', swa 'Talmai', hin 'तल्मै') while S145214 has the conjunctive waw prefix (eng 'and Talmai', spa 'y Talmai', arb 'وَتَلْمَايُ', swa 'na Talmai'). The split is purely grammatical — conjunction prefix — not a different referent or meaning.
